scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:local: pnpm run build --mode deploy && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck

APP_PASSWORD.description: Choose a unique WXDC sign-in password of at least 12 characters.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Generate a random signing secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CANTEEN_USER_NO.description: Enter your own canteen student number.

WECHAT_OPEN_ID.description: Use the OpenID of your WeChat account already bound in the official canteen portal.

WECHAT_JSESSIONID.description: Use a current JSESSIONID cookie from your own signed-in canteen session.

WECHAT_CENTER_ID.description: Use the default center ID of `9053`.
